english.title: Ride / drive etc vehicle etc in dangerous manner in a Royal Park - Royal Parks and Other Open Spaces Reg's 97

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Royal Parks and Other Open Spaces Regulations 1997

english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[rode an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ANIMAL..),]_
(B)_[drove a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(C)_[rode a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 3(10) of the Royal Parks and Other Open Spaces Regulations 1997 and section 2 of the Parks Regulation (Amendment) Act 1926.
